newsitem.title: UK: UK MMC set to approve London Clubs bid - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK MMC set to approve London Clubs bid - paper.

text.p: Britain's Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC) is expected to approve London Clubs International Plc's 190-million-pound bid for Capital Corporation Plc, the Times newspaper said on Saturday.
Neither gambling company would comment but the Times said "an insider at Capital Corp., which is resisting the takeover, confirmed that the bid looked likely to be waived through".
The MMC will reveal its decision on Monday in a report to President of the Board of Trade Margaret Beckett.
The hostile bid by London Clubs, which operates seven casinos in London, was referred to the MMC in April.

The Times said the MMC may attach conditions to its takeover approval that would allow Beckett to reject its recommendations and block the bid, following her closely watched decision last week to overturn an MMC decision on a major brewing linkup.
"There have been suggestions that the MMC might give the green light on condition that London Clubs sells one or two of its seven existing casinons," said the newspaper.
A merged company would have control of almost two-thirds of London's 1.7-billion-pound casino market, an increasingly attractive sector as rules on membership and drinking loosen.
